import requests, json

def get_mass(gene):
    url = "https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search"
    params = {
        "query": f"gene_exact:{gene} AND organism_id:9606 AND reviewed:true",
        "format": "json",
        "size": 1,
        "fields": "accession,gene_names,protein_name,mass,length,sequence"
    }
    r = requests.get(url, params=params, timeout=60)
    data = r.json()
    res = data["results"][0]
    acc = res["primaryAccession"]
    seq = res.get("sequence", {})
    mass = seq.get("molWeight")
    length = seq.get("length")
    return acc, mass, length

for gene in ["WBP4", "TEKT4"]:
    acc, mass, length = get_mass(gene)
    print(f"{gene}: accession={acc}, length={length} aa, molWeight={mass} Da = {mass/1000:.3f} kDa")</execute>', '================================== Ai Message ==================================
